content: sqlite.org/lang_vacuum.html (primary): VACUUM is a write operation - fails if another connection holds a lock preventing writes; fails with an open transaction or unfinalized statements on the same connection; needs up to 2x DB size free disk; in WAL mode only auto_vacuum can be changed. VACUUM INTO produces a consistent snapshot in a new file (target must not exist or be empty), original untouched, but unplanned shutdown mid-copy can leave incomplete/corrupt output; backup API uses fewer CPU cycles and is incremental. SIF has long-lived MCP connections + watch worker, so vacuum needs flock + quiesce or VACUUM INTO/backup API.
